description: Reviewable retained-case inventory derived by importing tests/harness.py through campaigns.recipes.helper and using scripts/campaign.py:native_configuration. Paths are relative to each named upstream source root; resolve roots from config/inputs.json or the live campaign receipt. This file records selection and final native controls, not managed acceptance.

derivation.ordering: info by sorted .in filename; encoder and reencoder by zero-based JSON index; absolute program last

apiVersion.reason: Upstream release v4.1.1 retains the 4.1.0.0 API version macro; no local patch.

comparison.info: Snapshot bytes after CRLF-to-LF only. Require native C return low byte to equal original CLI exit; nonzero returns require empty snapshot and failure bit. Three independent original CLI controls establish exits/stderr. Full native-vs-managed transcript comparison retains exact signed C return/status.
comparison.encoder: Original fuzz target must return 0 and consume all sizeof(actual ZydisEncoderRequest) input. Direct encode status and successful bytes are recorded and compared with native; direct encode rejection is not a skipped/failed fuzz case.
comparison.reencoder: Original target must return 0 and consume complete payload assembled from actual machine-mode/stack-width enum objects and fixture bytes; original C decode/re-encode checks remain.
comparison.absolute: One original executable case with its full branch, RIP/EIP-relative and range loops; return 0 and compare complete native transcript, including legitimate NOT ENCODABLE combinations.
comparison.managedDifferential: Exact complete stdout transcript bytes, without normalization, for each native/managed group; exact stderr bytes (concatenated original rejection stderr only for info, otherwise empty).
comparison.caseIntegrity: Exact ordered case IDs; reject missing/duplicate/incomplete markers, missing CASE PASS summaries, CHECK FAILED, nonzero group exit, signals, unexpected stderr or changed companion input identity.

managedEvidence.reason: Full verify was live at writing. Native evidence is not a managed-matrix acceptance claim.

testOnlyDependency.reason: Original CLI TTY/color handling only. Product has zero out-of-line Zycore units.
